items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: He was the piano player to that other guy that was a singer, he was a comedian. Johnny Ryan. This was it. Yeah, Johnny Ryan. He was the piano player. But he sat in with Sharky's band. He couldn't handle it.

ctx.x: I hope to look as good as you do at the piano. He was the piano player to that other guy that was a singer, he was a comedian. Johnny Ryan. This was it. Yeah, Johnny Ryan. He was the piano player. But he sat in with Sharky's band. He couldn't handle it.
